intelligence.human_view: Think of a house where every door handle is in the same place: back top left, your place top right, Keep reading dead center — on every page, in every room, so you never have to relearn where to look. The news has its own room now, just the news, and the weather and the horoscope have gone to their own places. The notification center is the front hall of that house: big numbers, big like the clock, in bigger blocks, every area that carries a notification listed there — nine for sure, three lives times messages, mail, and connections, plus the appointments that were missing — with three dropdowns to check them, one per life, and the whole room obsidian black in Wednesday's Kenya blue, each block lighting up in its own colour. The rows fit the count, so one glance tells you everything that is waiting. And the rule that governs the building of it is the plainest one of the night: a review is not an edit, a brief is not an edit — only a page changed is an edit.
intelligence.simple_view: Back goes top left, your place goes top right, and Keep reading sits in the center. News stands alone, with local news, province news, and global news. The big numbers show how many messages wait, in big blocks for each part of your life. Three drop-downs open your personal, business, and world news. Everything is black like obsidian, and each block lights up in its own color. A review is not an edit. Only a page that changed is an edit.
intelligence.grandma_view: Dear, the back button always sits in the top left corner, the little gauge that shows where you are sits in the top right, and Keep reading sits right in the center — the same three places on every page, so you never have to hunt for them. The news has its own room now, just local news, province news, and global news, all deep black through and through, with the weather back on the first slide and the horoscope in a room of its own. Your notification center shows the big numbers, big like the clock, in beautiful big blocks, and it lists every place that can send you a message — nine for sure, and the appointments that were missing — so you can see at one glance how many are waiting in each part of your life. The blocks are black and layered, lit in their own colours inside Wednesday's beautiful Kenya blue, and three little drop-downs open your personal, your business, and your world. And remember, dear: a review is not an edit, and a brief is not an edit — only a page that has actually changed is an edit.
intelligence.naya_view: Put the navigation in the same three places on every page — back top left, slideshow position top right, Keep reading dead center — with no exceptions, and confirm with the captain the one ~01:19Z line that put the back button top right on the appointments page. Make the news room obsidian all the way through with news only — local, province, global — and drop the "row seven to 11" wording; put the weather back on the first slide; give horoscope, Chinese horoscope, Bible daily quotes, and the meaning of the day their own space. Build the notification center with big real numbers in bigger blocks, the tab active-looking with a beautiful jewel icon, the word "notifications" shown once, never twice, and every Hub area that carries a notification counted out and listed in a row of beautiful blocks, in as many rows as the number needs, so the count reads at a glance. Give the center three dropdowns — personal, business, world. List the nine sources, and make world connections open to the worlds they came from, or just that world when there is only one; add notifications for appointments to the family, in the same blocks, the same count. Rebuild the center obsidian black with layers and real numbers; the purple background goes, Wednesday is Kenya; each block gloss in the middle, no glow, lighting up green, blue, and purple, inside the Kenya light. Lock in the sources — new intel for the day and the daily report — and ask the captain how that locked-in pair sits beside the nine and the appointments before building either list as the whole. And dispatch the round: a dictation is done when a build round carrying it is dispatched and the page changes, never when it is reviewed or briefed.
